mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tea_inquiry ( i_no, i_type, i_title, i_search, i_reply, i_email, i_phone, i_name, i_memo, i_file, i_define, i_img, p_no, m_id ) VALUES ( tea_inquiry_seq.NEXTVAL, #{i_type}, #{i_title}, #{i_search}, #{i_reply}, #{i_email}, #{i_phone}, #{i_name}, #{i_memo}, #{i_file, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{i_define}, #{i_img, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULLIF(#{p_no}, 0), #{m_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
